description: The LRM (§9.21) lets the table come from arrays as well as a file, and only the file form is implemented. Reading the arrays would mean folding a run-time array into a compile-time table, which is a different feature from the one this implements.
actions: Write the points to a file, one `x y` pair per line, and name it: `$table_model(x, "data.tbl")`.
For a noise PSD, `noise_table` already takes an inline list.
